article.content: Injury-riddled Philadelphia fall to defeat Chicago hold off Atlanta comeback in QB’s return Browns upset Ravens in absence of Lamar Jackson Bryce Young threw for 281 yards and two touchdowns to Tommy Tremble, and Chuba Hubbard ran for 120 yards and a score to lead the Carolina Panthers (3-2) past the injury-riddled Philadelphia Eagles (2-4). The Panthers had little trouble in the second half picking apart the Eagles, who were missing quarterback Jalen Hurts and running back Saquon Barkley. Hurts is on injured reserve and will miss at least four games with a blood clot in his calf . Tanner McKee started for Philadelphia and finished 26 of 45 for 215 yards and a touchdown.
